title: Anima Out of Hours with Pritesh Mistry
summary: The September 2026 event announcement: Pritesh Mistry and Dr Ben Walker discuss technology between primary and secondary care.
body_markdown:
Our first Out of Hours event brings Pritesh Mistry from The King’s Fund together with Anima’s Dr Ben Walker to discuss the changing relationship between primary and secondary care.


## What we will discuss


The conversation will cover Advice & Guidance, Single Points of Access, and the move from AI pilots to routine use. There will be an open Q&A so guests can put their questions to the speakers.


## Join us in Farringdon


The event is on 24 September 2026 at Anima HQ in Farringdon, London. Drinks and nibbles will be provided, and places are limited.


[See event details and RSVP](https://luma.com/b81mmsqv)


Out of Hours is a series of informal conversations about the challenges facing healthcare. This is the first event in the series.
